chunks: I heard Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
'Write down (our narrations), for indeed you will not preserve (them) until you write (them) down.'

key_terms.اكتبوا: Write down (imperative plural) — a direct command to record the Imam's teachings
key_terms.تحفظون: You preserve/memorize — referring to maintaining the accuracy and completeness of the narrations
key_terms.تكتبوا: You write down — the condition upon which preservation depends

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about writing down hadiths?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) commands his companions to write down hadiths, warning that oral memory alone is insufficient for preserving the prophetic and Imamic traditions. This tradition was transmitted by Abu Basir, one of the Imam's closest and most trusted companions. The directive reflects the Imam's concern during the Abbasid period — when Shia transmitters faced persecution — to ensure that his teachings would survive beyond his lifetime through written records.
